keyword_evidence: SERP_ONLY: public marketplace/category and education-resource pages show demand language around personalized back-to-school classroom rugs, AAC/core vocabulary communication boards, SPED classroom rugs, and feelings/emotion wheel classroom tools. No paid keyword volume, Search Console, or direct customer query data used.
buyer_summary: Buyer intent is a hypothesis from product evidence plus category SERP language: teachers, SPED staff, therapists, counselors, and parents want classroom rugs that combine decor with visible welcome, communication, regulation, or feelings-identification prompts.
purchase_concerns: Teacher-name spelling, symbol/readability accuracy, age and classroom fit, SPED/AAC appropriateness without overclaiming, size fit, non-slip backing, material feel, durability, washability or cleaning expectations, and whether the visual prompt matches the classroom's existing communication or SEL routines.
